title: AI Legal Brief: a German court holds an AI provider responsible for its AI's answers — June 2026

citations.claim: The Regional Court of Munich (Landgericht München) held that Google's AI Overviews are Google's own responsibility — not the sources' and not the users' — and that a provider presenting content as a coherent, autonomous, authoritative answer cannot transfer the entire burden of verification to the user.
citations.publisher: THE DECODER (Matthias Bastian, 9 June 2026: "Landmark German ruling declares Google's AI Overviews are Google's own words and makes it liable for false answers"). Publisher-level citation; deep-link to be pinned.

citations.claim: The EU AI Act places logging and human-oversight duties on the deployer of an AI system, discharged at the point of use rather than in a later review.
citations.publisher: Official Journal of the European Union
